neighbours.label: UK primary-school newsletter / class-page context: class names (e.g. 'Owls' class), 'Pupil Premium', 'long term plan', year-group curriculum talk
fire: This half term, Hedgehogs class have been learning about the Romans and made shields in DT.
A reminder to parents that Robins class will be swimming every Thursday afternoon this term.
Our school uses its Pupil Premium funding to provide breakfast club places for eligible children.
Please find below the medium term plan for Year 3, covering English, maths and topic work.
On Friday, Badgers class performed their class assembly and the parents loved it.
Year 1 children have been practising their phonics ready for the screening check in June.
Mrs Patel would like to thank all the parents who helped on the Foxes class trip to the farm.
Spellings for Kestrels class will be sent home in book bags every Monday.
quiet: Barn owls hunt over rough grassland at dusk, listening for voles in the grass.
The university announced new funding for postgraduate research students in engineering.
The company published its long-range strategic plan for the next decade of growth.
Hedgehogs hibernate through the winter and wake up hungry in early spring.
The American high school football team won its third game of the season on Friday.
Students at the college can apply for a scholarship to study abroad next year.
The robins returned to the garden feeder every morning during the cold snap.
The insurance premium for the new car was far higher than we expected.

notes: Card top examples are school class pages: 'Owls' class name x4, 'Pupil Premium', 'long term plan', year two spelling. Near misses keep the school/education theme but in non-UK-primary or non-newsletter register, or use owls as birds.
